knownGaps.description: Application RBAC and OAuth scopes are automated, but Account tenant isolation/RLS is not a satisfied production access-control contract until migrations and the runtime role enforce it end to end.
Authenticated Account pages are not covered by the daily cross-browser/accessibility/UI/cookie matrix; authenticated release acceptance is Chromium-only.
Weekly authenticated DAST uses a fixed credential for each scan and does not replace exhaustive SPA traversal or independent penetration work.
Fuzz and cross-platform execution are not wired into Account CI.
The current monkey test is a bounded public-route random walk; model-based authenticated monkey testing with shrinking is absent.
Only http-client has quantitative coverage thresholds; global Account Rust/TypeScript coverage gates are absent.
Public HTTP request campaigns exist, but large datasets and worker/Redis/SMTP backlog capacity are not covered.
SMTP remains at-least-once across provider acceptance plus database commit ambiguity; stable Message-ID does not guarantee provider deduplication.

knownGaps.control: Fresh recovery and DRP decision records are mandatory in the release-board-signed acceptance manifest.
knownGaps.description: DRP/failover is a human exercise rather than a scheduled automated campaign; its attribution is not yet an independent cryptographic signature.

The release board signs one root manifest, but individual human reports lack detached signatures and category-specific trusted signer allowlists; signedBy alone cannot prove separation of duties or an independent pentest.

The production gate has no exact-SHA automated-evidence manifest that verifies producer workflow provenance, freshness and digests for trusted-hermetic, browser, k6 and DAST artifacts; manual-command capability claims are not release evidence.

No externally pinned evidence importer with an ephemeral least-privilege credential, confidential ACL or encryption boundary, exact-SHA attestation, and redirect-safe DNS connection binding exists. Candidate-controlled code must not read the private evidence store, raw reports must not be published as application-repository Actions artifacts, and a preflight DNS result must be bound to the actual TLS connection to eliminate rebinding and resolution-to-connect TOCTOU.
Fresh and N-1 upgrades are automated, but backup/PITR restoration and forward-fix remain to be proven.
The workload comparator lacks a trusted control-plane adapter for deployment identity, immutable release and ready replicas.
